column1: # What the code NativeContractTable.Net11.tsv cites in .NET 11's pinned runtime source calls, where its row does not cite that too: each a function or macro vouched for, by reading it, as running no managed code.

# TestNativeContractTable holds every call that a routine a row cites makes, as the text spells it, to a routine the row cites or one vouched for here, matching by name, or, for a branch whose target the text does not name, by the routine that makes it.

#   callee   path:symbol under src/coreclr (a path may climb out of it, as ../native/minipal does), as the contract table cites one, with =spelling after it where a macro pastes the name together, giving the text that defines it; or -:symbol for a function of the C library or the operating system; or path:routine::<indirect> for the branches through a register or memory that the assembly routine routine of path makes, whose targets its text does not name; or path:routine::<callee> for the calls of callee that the routine routine of path makes, and no others

#   runs     nothing (it runs no managed code); exception (it runs no managed code but the constructor of the exception it throws); loads (it runs no managed code when every type it loads is found without the program's assembly resolution handlers, so every row whose code calls it holds under NamedTypesLoad); malformed (it runs no managed code but the constructor of the exception it throws, which it throws only for a metadata reader's failing HRESULT, so every row whose code calls it holds under MetadataWellFormed); or unreached (it may run anything, and the cited code calls it only on a path the native never takes)
